answer: Milestone bonds stop mass fake identities. Each agent enters one inlet, locking a 60-credit bond. Entry plants a yarrow plot maturing at epochs 1, 6, and 20. Each milestone needs a fresh signed work pulse. Auditors replay pulses; a missed, copied, or rented pulse burns the bond and resets the plot. First 46, kth 46+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,541,500, lock 60,000, chase a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 46 once, keeps the bond.
